Limited explicit structural revision of data adaptation and removal of unrequested work. Preserve every accepted requirement exactly, the sole public query input, non-null products with nullable missing fields, maximum ten in original order, Browser search and individual product visits, actual workbook writing at the fixed destination, and closeBrowser cleanup even on failure. Do not change permissions or limits. Correct the retained proposal as follows.
1. Remove the unrequested detectCookieConsent and acceptCookiesIfPresent tasks and their nested action; do not replace them with other unrequested work. Preserve the requested search. Neither a selector literal guessed from prior knowledge nor a declared boolean establishes observed action identity. Obtain search arguments from the actual observed records, using the discovered typed contracts and producer-compatible actions.
2. Use complete bounded observation pages for independent extraction. each.input must equal the actual named bound collection input (for example pages); each.output names the sole declared result field. resultType describes the complete assembled output: one compact candidate array per source page means rows: array<array<Candidate>>, followed by one-level flatten(rows). Process every page, including empty candidate arrays; retain authoritative completeness metadata and original observations separately. Never field-select a property directly from an array; a necessary minimal typed foreach can select fields from item and export arrays before flatten.
3. Give each interpretation only the explicit compact fields needed by its immediate decision, never the full snapshot/content alongside that view. Keep original observed references, supported actions and URLs separately. Interpretation selects observed IDs only; lookup those IDs against offered candidates before lookup against original observations. Preserve repetitions and source order, selecting only the requested first ten products at most, with no additional ranking, filtering or deduplication. Extraction does not perform business selection.
4. Retain real per-product URL navigation and observed extraction. Use complete observations or consume authoritative continuation, and assert actual producer success/completeness before treating absence as business missing data. Product output records themselves are non-null, while name/description/price/url/error retain the accepted nullable field contracts. Use direct typed loop exports for already-typed records instead of asking assembleWorkbook/finalStatus to recreate products.
5. Retain one bounded TSV-formatting transform over at most ten compact product rows, preserving exact values and ordering. Remove finalStatus inference used only for copies/status assembly. Return products directly from the typed collected records, xlsxPath from the successful writer's declared output, and success from real typed producer values, retaining local requires before affected work. A literal path or model-declared completion does not prove writing. Do not use choice on an operation; use typed output references. Preserve writing and cleanup ordering.
Use only the existing exact discovered contracts and binding vocabulary. Preserve unrelated business work; this is not authority to change accepted intent or fabricate values.
